question: Can you find 5 delivery drivers with the highest average number of daily deliveries?
sql:
WITH daily_counts AS (
  SELECT deliveries.driver_id, orders.order_created_year, orders.order_created_month, orders.order_created_day, COUNT(*) as daily_delivery_count
  FROM deliveries
  JOIN orders ON deliveries.delivery_order_id = orders.delivery_order_id
  WHERE deliveries.driver_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY deliveries.driver_id, orders.order_created_year, orders.order_created_month, orders.order_created_day
),
driver_averages AS (
  SELECT driver_id, AVG(daily_delivery_count) as avg_daily_deliveries
  FROM daily_counts
  GROUP BY driver_id
)
SELECT driver_id, ROUND(avg_daily_deliveries, 2) as avg_daily_deliveries
FROM driver_averages
ORDER BY avg_daily_deliveries DESC
LIMIT 5
